newsitem.title: ITALY: Piedmont seeks no allies for PC venture - Rossignolo.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont seeks no allies for PC venture - Rossignolo.

text.p: Piedmont International, the newly formed company which is buying Olivetti Personal Computers, has already worked out its structure and is not seeking new partners, its chairman designate said.
Piedmont's Gianmario Rossignolo, who is also chairman of Electrolux's Zanussi unit, said: "We are not searching for a single new partner.
"We have found the money, the partners are already there, I'm one of those investing money to try to bring this reality as soon as possible to positive results," he said.

Olivetti said on Monday it was selling its loss-making PCs to the Piedmont group of domestic and international investors brought together by Edward Gottesman, the U.S. lawyer behind the Centenary group. Olivetti is to hold 10 percent of Piedmont.

Rossignolo, in Bologna for a meeting of engineering employers' association Federmeccanica, said for now no further details of the venture could be given and he did not state what his share in Piedmont would be. Milan newsroom +392-66129507
